name: Shallum
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy

points: Hilkiah and the men go to Huldah the prophetess, wife of Shallum, who dwells in the college in Jerusalem, and she declares the word of the Lord God of Israel.

note.label: 2 Chronicles 34: Josiah the Wise Child Finds the Book of the Law
